description: Accommodations for students with ADHD or executive function disorders affecting focus, organization, and time management
specific_accommodations: 50% additional time on exams and timed assessments
Testing in a quiet, distraction-reduced environment
Permission to use fidget tools or take movement breaks
Preferential seating at front of classroom
Assignment deadline reminders sent 48 hours in advance
Use of organizational apps and tools during exams (non-internet connected)
Permission to submit assignments in multiple parts
notes: Student may benefit from academic coaching or tutoring services. Encourage use of campus ADHD support groups.
